title: Battle Simulator
description: GM tool for Black Flag: put creatures on a map and watch them fight it out. Sides are the tokens' dispositions (friendly, neutral, hostile). Each creature moves, uses its real attacks, multiattack, saving-throw abilities, recharge abilities, spells, healing and legendary actions, with Automated Animations or JB2A effects, and every roll goes to a GM-only chat card. A Reset button puts positions, hit points and uses back as they were. Macros (Simulate Battle, Stop Battle, Reset Battle) are made in the Macro Directory.
